account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 14:22 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE 14:17 HOURLY. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. Unchanged from the 13:22 read and from every read since 11:22 on 8/24 because nothing has traded - a conclusion drawn from a fresh pull, not an assumption that let the pull be skipped. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which is what discharges this slot's exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop or time stop is reachable because no position carries one, and no option no-fly window is reachable because no contract is held. ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22 confirms from the broker that nothing has been executed, which is how it is established that the specification is still live and still confirmable rather than inferred from an empty position list. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. ONE SPECIFICATION IS STILL LIVE AND WAS RE-QUOTED THIS HOUR RATHER THAN ASSUMED: BZ, 24 shares at a 15.95 limit, published 09:47, FORCED on item 2, fused to 15:30 ET today. It was CONFIRMED at 14:22 against a 16.22 bid / 16.23 ask with all three of its pre-registered invalidations tested and none tripped, and the limit is NOT raised. 24 at 15.95 is 382.80 against 1009.16 settled, 37.9% against the 40% single-name ceiling, so it remains affordable and inside concentration exactly as struck. THE FINDING OF THIS HOUR INVERTS THE CHARACTER OF LAST HOUR RATHER THAN REPEATING ITS CONCLUSION: last hour BZ drifted back toward the struck price on thinning volume, this hour a single 106,436-share minute at 13:55 took it UP to a 16.340 high, so the limit moved further away on demand taking offers rather than resting near it on none. The operator was notified with 68 minutes left on the fuse, because the only later run fires at roughly 15:22 with eight.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 1 - reported before the open on 8/25, SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 15.95 limit for 24 shares, FORCED on item 2
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED LIVE AT 14:22 FOR THE FIFTH HOURLY RUNNING, LIMIT NOT RAISED, AND THE LEVEL DID NOT PRINT FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR. BZ is 16.22 bid / 16.23 ask at 18:22:47.430754584Z, last trade 16.220 at 18:22:33.257526810Z, +5.05% against the 15.440 settled close on a 0.06% spread. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED MECHANICALLY AND NONE TRIPPED, with the margin on each recorded rather than asserted. FIRST, a print below 15.44: NOT TRIPPED - the lowest post-publication print is still 15.680 in the 10:00 bar, 0.240 clear, and this hour's deepest print is 16.075, above the limit itself. SECOND, a bid above 16.75 at any hourly re-quote: NOT TRIPPED - the bid is 16.22, 0.530 under the line. This is the highest re-quote bid of the session, 16.16 then 16.11 then 16.08 and now 16.22, so the margin is narrowing and that is stated plainly; but even the 16.460 session high set at 11:10 is 0.290 below the kill, so no print today has approached it. THIRD, a five-minute close below 15.71 on volume above the preceding bar: NOT TRIPPED, and it still fails on BOTH halves - no five-minute bar has closed below 15.71 at any point today, the lowest post-publication close is 15.755 in the 10:00 bar and that bar traded 48,093 shares against 59,354 in the one before it, and this hour's lowest close is 16.100, a full 0.39 above the level. THE UNREACHABLE STRETCH IS NOW THE LONGEST OF THE SESSION AT 132 MINUTES. The last touch of 15.95 was the 12:10 minute bar, low exactly 15.950; the next minute low was 15.990 and from 12:14 onward the session minimum is 16.065, set at 12:54. That beats the roughly 60-minute 10:54-11:52 gap. Cumulative reachability stays FROZEN at roughly 75 minutes across three windows and did not gain a fourth, so there is NO NEW DELIVERY MISS and the count stands at thirteen - a miss requires a marketable level and there was not one. THE HOUR'S CHARACTER INVERTED, WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE LAST HOUR'S CONFIRM RESTED ON IT. The 13:22 run read the drift back to the struck 16.08 bid on thinning volume - roughly 251,000 shares, 5,098 on the 13:15 bar - as a rest rather than a failing reversal. This hour gave the opposite evidence pointing the other way: 106,436 shares in the single 13:55 minute, roughly thirty times the ambient minute size, lifting 16.205 to a 16.340 high inside two minutes on roughly 317,000 for the hour. Demand taking offers, not supply resting. Good for the thesis and bad for the fill, and those are two different things. THE HONEST NUMBER AGAINST THE CONFIRM: the entry was struck 0.13 below a 16.08 bid, 0.81% out; it is now 0.27 below a 16.22 bid, 1.66% out. The gap a fill must close has roughly DOUBLED since publication and needs a 1.7% give-back inside 68 minutes in a name pressing its highs. On plain arithmetic this specification is more likely to expire than to fill. That is a reason to say so, not a reason to re-strike higher - invalidation two defines when a level has been left behind at 16.75 and the bid is 0.530 short of it, and raising the limit to chase would be the behaviour refused against FUTU on 8/24 and against BJ this same morning.
entryWatch.why: THE ENTRY IS FORCED ON ITEM 2 AND ON NOTHING ELSE, AND THE MARKING IS CONSISTENCY RATHER THAN SCRUPLE. BZ is +4.15%, not the +8% item 2 names outright, so the literal test is untripped - but the rule's stated preference is the day-2/3 pullback and not the spike, this is the spike day, and this board floored PDD on exactly that reasoning twenty-four hours ago. What makes it worth forcing: Q2 EPS 0.33 against 0.29 verified on a live calendar pull, a 13.8% beat, within half a point of the 14.3% that carried BJ yesterday, on a name marked DOWN into its own report - 17.46 on 8/10 to a 15.07 low and a 15.44 close on 8/24, the lowest close of the month, set on the session immediately before the print. That is item 5 in the shape that favours an entry rather than the crowded-bulls shape that refuses one. Then the tape did the thing worth paying for: gapped DOWN through that close to 15.21 in the first minute and was bought back to 16.31 inside four minutes, the exact inverse of UI opening at the high of the day and losing 13.7%, and of BEKE giving back an opening pop twice. The honest weakness, recorded beside it: the +20% target at 19.14 is above anything BZ has traded this month, the 8/10 high being 17.47.

candidatesNote: Twenty-two names, every row a real timestamped bid pulled between 13:42:20Z and 13:46:51Z rather than a blend or a carried price. THE SHAPE OF THE MORNING IS THE EXACT REVERSE OF YESTERDAY'S AND THAT IS WHAT PICKED - AND WHAT REFUSED - TODAY'S ENTRY. On 8/24 the index was modestly lower while the high-beta complex was liquidated 5-6% and every recent reporter in consumer and retail was green. Today SPY is 766.39 bid, UP 0.38%, QQQ is 712.60, UP 0.89%, and the complex that was sold is being bought back hard: SMCI +7.54%, FUTU +4.86%, NVDA +2.30%, SMR +1.66%, OKLO +1.56%. Every defensive reporter that led yesterday is red - BJ -1.74%, WMT -1.46%, ROST -1.37%, TJX -0.43%, BKE -1.87%. The rotation that was the stated reason to own BJ has inverted inside one session, which is why BJ is refused today on its tape as well as on the FUTU principle. THE STRONGEST TAPE ON THE BOARD IS THE ONE THE 8/21 BRANCH FORBIDS, and today is the first of the three sessions - 8/25, 8/26, 8/27 - it was written six sessions early to govern, with NVDA reporting tomorrow after the bell and MRVL on 8/27. Refusing that complex cost nothing yesterday and costs something today, which is the whole test of a branch. SEVEN NAMES REPORTED THIS MORNING BEFORE THE OPEN AND WERE PRICED ON LIVE QUOTES: BZ beat 0.33 against 0.29 and was SPECIFIED at a 15.95 limit for 24 shares, FORCED on item 2 as day 1 of its own print; BNS beat 1.65 against 1.53 and is refused on the WMT arithmetic; BMO beat 2.86 against 2.71 and is DOWN 0.40%; DKS missed 3.53 against 3.88 and is down 22.83%; VIPS missed 0.12 against 0.51 and is UP 1.33%, which is its own warning; NSSC beat and is down 3.65%; MZTI beat. FOURTEEN NAMES WERE RANKED IN TOTAL and the ranking is published in why.json rather than implied - the only candidate that passes item 2 outright is BJ, and it is refused because this board killed it in writing yesterday and the tape has come back UNDER the dead level, which is the FUTU principle applied on the morning it costs something. FUTU itself is the number that cuts against this board: 121.24 bid, 3.34 ABOVE the level withdrawn on 8/21 and up 4.86%, so a discipline that was free yesterday is expensive today and is still not re-struck.

candidates.note: 16.08 bid / 16.12 ask at 13:46:51.835700189Z, last 16.100, +4.15% against a 15.440 close on a 0.25% spread - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 15.95 limit for 24 shares, FORCED on item 2. Q2 EPS 0.330 against a 0.290 estimate reported this morning before the open, verified on a live calendar pull: a 13.8% beat, within half a point of the 14.3% that carried BJ yesterday. ITEM 5 IS THE REASON IT RANKS FIRST: BZ was marked DOWN into its own report, 17.46 on 8/10 to a 15.07 low and a 15.44 close on 8/24 - the lowest close of the month, set on the session immediately before the print. THE TAPE IS THE SECOND REASON: it gapped DOWN through that close to 15.21 in the first minute and was bought back to 16.31 inside four minutes, pulled back to 15.71 at 09:38 and is pressing the highs again. Roughly 503,000 shares in the first fifteen minutes against a ~4.7M run rate. Forced because it is day 1 - the spike day item 2 prefers a pullback to - at +4.15% rather than the +8% the rule names outright.

96.78 bid / 97.13 ask at 13:45:18.018929939Z, last 96.800, -1.74% against a 98.490 close on a 0.36% spread. THE ONLY CANDIDATE ON THIS BOARD THAT PASSES ITEM 2 - day 3, a genuine pullback into the 96.420 close of its own print day, off a verified 14.3% beat with the 88.220 pre-print markdown carrying item 5 - AND REFUSED ANYWAY. It is now BELOW the 97.35 limit this board killed in writing at 11:22 yesterday, which is the FUTU shape exactly: a level withdrawn in writing does not become live again because the tape came back under it. The fresh look yesterday's row permitted was taken and the tape answered it - the rotation that was the stated reason to own BJ has inverted. Opened 98.10, low 96.315.

The closest structural rival to today's entry.

Refused on its own pre-written trigger, a five-minute close back above 18.47 on volume, which has not fired: on 8/24 it opened 18.055, printed 18.47 within five minutes and closed at 17.710, EXACTLY the session low - a third consecutive failed pop.
